findings.comment: Adjacent land uses are not documented on all four sides of the site. East boundary shows labels for Existing Apartment Building and Clarion Ridge Condominiums, but north, south, and west boundaries lack specific land use designations. All four sides must be labeled.

applicableAreas: adjacent properties across Valley View Road
findings.comment: Adjoining properties across adjacent streets and rights-of-way (particularly south, across Valley View Road) are not clearly labeled with specific land use designations on the site plan.

Adjacent zoning designations are not shown for all property boundaries. North and east boundaries show zoning (MF-4-CO and MF-2-CO respectively), but south and west boundaries lack zoning designations despite being adjacent to other zoning districts.

Site plan shows MF-4-CO zoning on the north boundary, but facts.md (based on current GIS records) does not list MF-4-CO among the adjacent properties. Adjacent properties are documented as SF-3, GO, MF-3, MF-3-CO, and MF-2-CO. Zoning designations shown on site plan may be inaccurate or inconsistent with current City GIS zoning records.

Site abuts multiple zoning districts but zoning boundary lines are not shown or labeled for all boundaries. Zoning is partially labeled on the north and east boundaries only. Sheets where each zoning boundary is depicted are not identified.

Zoning designations are not included on the mylars (recorded plat, Sheet 2). The plat shows only legal boundaries and easements without zoning information. Zoning is shown only on the engineered site plan (Sheet 9), and even there only partially (north and east boundaries only).

Existing building footprints on adjoining properties within 50 feet of the site are shown only on the east boundary (Existing Apartment Building and Clarion Ridge Condominiums). No existing building footprints are shown for adjacent properties to the north, south, or west, despite the SF-3 parcel (north) being an immediate neighbor with structures, and other residential/office properties adjoining the site.

Off-street parking consists of 88 spaces (10 surface + 78 garage) in a residential district adjoining other residential-district properties. The landscape plan shows a wooden privacy fence along property boundaries and parking buffer trees, but fence height is not specified. Cannot verify compliance with the 6-foot minimum height requirement for parking screening adjacent to residential properties. Provide fence height specifications.

Buildings have up to 3 stories. Site plan specifies that exterior lighting will be 'full cut-off and fully shielded in compliance with Subchapter E 2.5,' but does not explicitly state whether any fixtures are located above the second floor facing adjacent residential properties. General Site Plan Notes require no lighting above the second floor adjacent to residential property. Provide explicit confirmation that no exterior lighting is installed above the second floor facing residential properties.

Multi-family residential use includes mechanical equipment (HVAC, etc.) that will be located adjacent to residential properties. No mechanical equipment schedule or noise specifications are provided on the site plan. Cannot verify that mechanical equipment noise will not exceed 70 dB(A) at the property line adjacent to residential uses. Provide mechanical equipment specifications including noise ratings in dB(A) at property line distance.
